name: ship-debugged-code
description: Find the real cause of a failure and fix it properly: see it fail, explain everything that was observed, fix where it starts, see it gone, and say plainly what was not verified. Does not silence the symptom, looks for the same cause elsewhere, and leaves uncommitted work untouched while investigating. Also reviews bug fixes and postmortems. Any language, with notes for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript and Java.
